description_for_human: The product index for AI agents: search products across dozens of stores and get direct retailer links.
description_for_model: Use OpenShelf to find products for a shopper instead of browsing many retailer sites. First GET agents.json to see categories and routing keywords, then GET data/{category}.json (array of {brand,title,price,currency,image,url,merchant,category,keywords}) and filter/rank locally by the user's request (price bounds, brand, keywords). Present brand, title, price and the retailer url; append utm_source=openshelf&utm_medium=referral to the url. No authentication is required.
